coverage_gaps: Citation-graph and DOI metadata routes are unavailable, limiting backward and forward citation expansion beyond links exposed through PubMed.
Non-FDA regulator databases are unavailable, so actions from EMA and other jurisdictions cannot be systematically compared.
Preprint servers and additional subject indexes are unavailable, limiting coverage of unreviewed or non-MEDLINE evidence.
Full-text publisher correction pages may fall outside the available routes when PubMed has not indexed the notice.
ClinicalTrials.gov historical change records may require interface-level review beyond ordinary query results to establish the exact timing of amended outcomes or results.
exclusion_criteria: Preclinical, animal, in vitro, and mechanism-only records without decision-relevant human safety evidence.
Tofacitinib studies in conditions other than rheumatoid arthritis unless they directly informed an FDA action applicable to marketed rheumatoid arthritis use.
Efficacy-only reports lacking cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, mortality, or regulatory safety information.
Narrative commentary, news coverage, or secondary summaries that provide no independently traceable primary evidence or regulatory action.
Duplicate canonical records after identifier-based merging, while retaining every query-to-record occurrence and source link.
Records first made available after 2024-12-31, except later correction or retraction notices flagged solely as post-cutoff evidence-integrity updates.
Unverifiable claims lacking a recoverable PubMed record, ClinicalTrials.gov record, or FDA regulatory document within the available routes.
inclusion_criteria: Records available on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, and regulatory effective dates recorded separately.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its result history, the primary peer-reviewed publication, linked analyses, and FDA actions that cite or materially interpret the study.
Adult rheumatoid arthritis evidence evaluating marketed tofacitinib and reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or mortality outcomes.
Randomized trials, postauthorization studies, registry analyses, observational cohorts, claims studies, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses that can qualify or conflict with the pivotal findings.
FDA safety communications, prescribing-information revisions, boxed warnings, postmarketing requirements, and indication restrictions with jurisdiction and date preserved.
Corrections, errata, retraction notices, expressions of concern, and superseding regulatory updates linked to included evidence.
All languages when bibliographic metadata permits eligibility assessment, with translation limitations recorded during screening.
Each included claim must retain links to its registry identifier, publication identifier, regulatory document, source query, and retrieval wave where available.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal study publication family and validate trial names, identifiers, and drug terminology.
queries.query: ("tofacitinib"[Title/Abstract] OR "Xeljanz"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry record and verify sponsor protocol identity, population, comparators, outcomes, dates, and posted results.
Confirm that FDA materials identify the postauthorization study and establish regulatory terminology.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz NCT02092467 OR ORAL Surveillance safety communication

queries.purpose: Retrieve high-recall rheumatoid arthritis safety evidence across all decision-relevant outcomes.
queries.query: ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Tofacitinib"[Mesh] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690550"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Identify registered tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis studies with relevant safety outcomes and potential qualifying evidence.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch]"Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch](tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (AREA[OutcomeMeasure](cardiovascular OR malignancy OR cancer OR thrombosis OR thromboembolism OR mortality OR death))

queries.purpose: Retrieve FDA safety communications, labeling materials, reviews, and dated actions across the outcome domains.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz cardiovascular cancer thrombosis blood clots death rheumatoid arthritis

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary publication and related analyses for the co-primary cardiovascular and malignancy outcomes.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Capture registry outcome definitions, analysis populations, posted results, and adverse-event tables for comparison with the publication.
queries.query: NCT02092467 primary outcomes major adverse cardiovascular events malignancies excluding non-melanoma skin cancer results adverse events

queries.purpose: Recover the principal FDA action based on final trial findings and preserve its effective date and risk language.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz FDA requires warnings increased risk serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death September 2021

queries.purpose: Recover earlier FDA interim actions concerning thrombosis and mortality and place them chronologically.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz FDA safety announcement pulmonary embolism death 10 mg February 2019 July 2019 boxed warning

queries.purpose: Retrieve analyses that qualify risk by age, smoking, baseline cardiovascular risk, dose, or other effect modifiers.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (post hoc[Title/Abstract] OR subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR age[Title/Abstract] OR smok*[Title/Abstract] OR risk factor*[Title/Abstract] OR dose[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Find external observational, registry, and meta-analytic evidence that supports, qualifies, or conflicts with the pivotal trial.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR "real world"[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Challenge the assessment with focused thrombosis and mortality evidence, including dose-specific and cause-specific findings.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields])) AND ("venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, errata, retractions, retraction notices, or expressions of concern affecting pivotal or related evidence.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (correction[Title] OR erratum[Publication Type] OR retraction[Title] OR retracted publication[Publication Type] OR "expression of concern"[Title])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Check whether FDA corrected, superseded, or withdrew relevant communications or labeling conclusions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz label boxed warning correction recall withdrawal retraction safety communication update

queries.purpose: Capture later publications, critiques, updated analyses, and evidence-integrity notices through the assessment cutoff.
queries.query: ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title]) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Safety PECO: adults with rheumatoid arthritis, especially patients aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor; marketed tofacitinib exposure compared with tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or other relevant rheumatoid arthritis therapies; outcomes of major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous or arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cause-specific mortality through 2024-12-31. Link the pivotal postauthorization study across registry, primary publication, related analyses, and dated FDA actions, while identifying qualifying or conflicting evidence and correction, retraction, or expression-of-concern status.
stop_rules: Stop after all 16 planned query events have been executed or the candidate query-event budget is exhausted, and report any unexecuted event as a coverage limitation.
Require recovery of NCT02092467, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, and the principal FDA interim and final safety actions before declaring anchor coverage complete.

Require bidirectional reconciliation of registry identifiers, study title, sponsor protocol identifier, population, doses, comparators, outcome definitions, and dates across registry, publication, and FDA materials.
Continue expansion until two consecutive expansion events add no new decision-relevant study, outcome estimate, effect modifier, regulatory action, or evidence-integrity notice.
Complete at least one challenge search covering each of cardiovascular risk, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, and correction or retraction status.
Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval when indexing or provider date semantics are ambiguous, and document excluded post-cutoff records.
Stop earlier only if every available route is complete, all anchors and outcome domains are covered, and further retrieval within the allowed routes cannot change the safety conclusion.
Preserve deterministic deduplication by PMID, NCT identifier, FDA document identity, DOI, and sponsor protocol identifier while retaining all query-to-record links.
